name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

files.content:
Class form

np-avatar with an img and a fallback. The image sits on top; if it fails, onerror hides it.

CN

Data-attribute form

data-np-avatar and the data-np-avatar-* parts, no classes.

CN

Fallback only

No image, or one that cannot load (the second one points to a missing file).

CN MS

Sizes

np-avatar-sm, default, np-avatar-lg, or data-size.

CN CN CN CN

Badge

np-avatar-badge sits at the bottom end corner. Set --np-avatar-badge-color to recolour it.

CN CN CN

Badge with icon

The icon is hidden on the small size.

PP PP

Group

np-avatar-group overlaps its avatars.

CN LR ER

Group count

np-avatar-group-count with text or an icon.

CN LR ER
+3
CN LR ER

Group sizes

The count follows the size of the avatars in its group.

CN LR
+3
CN LR
+3

Shape

Set --np-avatar-radius for a rounded square.

CN
